description: A traversal in parentheses is not a static traversal
notes: The spec makes a variable expression with attribute access and constant index operations a static traversal without saying whether parentheses, which only group in evaluation, keep it one. hashicorp/hcl keeps the parentheses as a ParenthesesExpr (hclsyntax/expression.go), which has no AsTraversal method and can't be unwrapped, so hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr reports an error.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
